newsitem.title: USA: Balmoral acquires Houston manufacturing plant.
newsitem.headline: Balmoral acquires Houston manufacturing plant.

text.p: Balmoral Group Ltd said Tuesday it acquired a 310,000-square-foot facility in north Houston to make flotation products for oil and natural gas projects operating in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico and around the world.
By June, Balmoral will begin producing rigid and flexible riser buoyancy modules for the drilling market and will ultimately be capable of producing 100 modules a day, the company said.
Balmoral will continue to manufacture buoyancy modules in its headquarters manufacturing plant in Aberdeen, Scotland, primarily for the North Sea market.
